questions.question: Through Zechariah, God spoke to people who had fasted and mourned for seventy years. What did He ask them about it?

answers.text: Whether it was really for Him

questions.question: Through the prophet Zechariah, the LORD of Hosts told His people to administer true justice. True or false?
What did God tell His people through Zechariah not to do to the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner and the poor?
